description: This file defines an abstract base class for implementing custom secret managers in the LiteLLM framework, providing an interface for reading, writing, deleting secrets, and performing health checks, to be extended by user-defined secret manager classes.

classes.name: CustomSecretManager
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating custom secret manager integrations within LiteLLM, defining asynchronous and synchronous methods for secret operations.

methods.name: Optional[str] async_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously read a secret from the custom secret management system.

methods.name: Optional[str] sync_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to synchronously read a secret from the custom secret management system.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] async_write_secret( self, secret_name: str, secret_value: str, description: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, tags: Optional[Union[dict, list]] = None, )
methods.description: Optional asynchronous method to write a secret to the secret management system; by default raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: dict async_delete_secret( self, secret_name: str, recovery_window_in_days: Optional[int] = 7, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Optional asynchronous method to delete a secret; by default raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: bool validate_environment(self)
methods.description: Method to validate environment variables and configurations; can be overridden.

methods.name: bool async_health_check( self, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None )
methods.description: Performs a health check on the secret manager; can be overridden.
